title: Email/query: limit is always Some(n) after parsing but typed as Option<u64>
description: After parsing, limit: Option<u64> is never None — absent/null maps to Some(256) and invalid is rejected. Yet it is passed as Option<u64> to query_objects and unwrapped with .unwrap_or(256) in the collapseThreads path (the or(256) branch is dead). Type should be u64 for the parsed local variable; only convert to Option<u64> when calling backend.query_objects if None means 'no limit'. Current code: the backend never receives None for limit from Email/query, so it cannot distinguish 'client asked for no limit' from 'client asked for 256'.
